searchText: Any idea why CI isn't running for this consensus-specs PR? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3171 Posting here cause otherwise will be lost on interop. Prysm will allow BLS changes to be included in the pool before Capella. Do you guys thing we should be broadcasting these as soon as we subscribe or after the fork? Currently you’d need to wait until the head block of your peers is in Capella or it will be rejected as invalid because gossip is validated against the current head state. Hence Teku just rejects bls changes before Capella because they aren’t going to be gossiped reliably and users are better off submitting later and avoiding the gossip chaos. yeah I was thinking on broadcasting twice: once at subscription and then again at the fork epoch but I am worried of being banned or something if doing it before the fork if clients mark them as invalid and then don't take them again. Prysm will take them as valid if it gets them from gossip before Capella, as long as they are signed correctly with the Capella fork The problem is that once they're seen and marked invalid, they will be ignored even if received again after the Capella fork. ignored in this case meaning treated as duplicate - likely the libp2p layer will remember them as invalid but not sure of the details of that. I have no idea of the exact numbers, but for sure there are at least _some_ stolen mnemonics (of validators with 0x00 credentials). So if the cutoff is the Capella fork, I do expect at least a little burst/rush/spam to get those withdrawal credential changes in. yeah this is my biggest worry, then gossiping right at the fork may be a problem as well. Yeah, but that's not that much of a problem if the biggest pools have them whitelisted in their operations pool already Not sure if there's any whitelisting tbh, I thought that idea had died. I'd say that I'd still expect spam regardless. Are any client teams building whitelisting in to their nodes?

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content:
Currently you’d need to wait until the head block of your peers is in Capella or it will be rejected as invalid because gossip is validated against the current head state. 
Hence Teku just rejects bls changes before Capella because they aren’t going to be gossiped reliably and users are better off submitting later and avoiding the gossip chaos.
